info.title: fivem-nui-contracts - generate TypeScript contract declarations from C# NUI DTOs.
info.description: Generates TypeScript contract declarations from C# NUI DTOs.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Only generate [NuiContract]/[NuiEvent] types under this namespace.

options.name: --type
options.description: Generate a specific type instead of scanning. Repeatable.

options.name: --doc
options.description:
XML documentation file for TSDoc comments. Repeatable;
defaults to the assembly's sibling .xml when present.

options.name: --null
options.description: Nullable member style: optional (default) or nullable.

options.name: --no-event-map
options.description: Do not emit the NuiEventMap module augmentation.

options.name: --core-module
options.description: Module augmented with the event map. Defaults to @fivem-nui/core.

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Write to standard output instead of a file.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 generation error, 2 usage error.
fivem-nui-contracts - generate TypeScript contract declarations from C# NUI DTOs.
